description: Quarantine flaky tests: they keep running and being reported, but their failures stop failing run-test and the ci command until the entry expires (default 14 days, max 90). add needs owner and reason; list shows what is quarantined and what expired; remove ends it. Stored in playwright-quarantine.json (commit it).

days.description: add: how long it counts (default 14, max 90)

file.description: Spec file, relative to the project

index.description: add: the Nth failure of the last run instead of test/file/title

owner.description: add: who will fix it (name or @handle)

reason.description: add: why it is flaky, or the issue link

test.description: The test as 'file › title' (as get-failure and analyze-history print it), or use file + title

title.description: Test title, or its last parts ('Checkout › pays by card')

name: quarantine

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Quarantine flaky tests
